topic.title: Public Rights of Way / Diversion / Stopping Up
topic.source_contract: definitive map and statement, route status and width, planning relationship, order power, alternative route, consultation, objections, confirmation, works, opening and ongoing accessibility evidence

scope_guards: A route absent from an online map is not proof that no public right exists.
Planning permission does not automatically stop up or divert a highway.
An order application is not a confirmed order.
An unopposed order is not treated as confirmed until formally completed.
A confirmed order is not evidence that replacement works are complete.
Constructed surfacing is not treated as legal opening.
A temporary closure is not treated as permanent extinguishment.
No score or promotion is written without exact legal order, works, opening and accessibility evidence.
